text:
Palladium Price in 1990
Among 9 monthly observations available for 1990, the LBMA palladium price fell 29.4% between 1990-04-30 ($117) and 1990-12-28 ($82.55). The highest sampled price was $119 in May and the lowest was $82.55 in December. The mean of these observations was $105. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
